conditions.text: C3 — Nearness is by place, meaning, quality (prayatna) and measure; place is strongest. Kāśikā examples: 6.1.101, 6.3.34 (puṃvat), 7.3.52, 8.2.80, 8.4.62; guṇa चेता/स्तोता.
